import zlib, struct

raw = open('/app/sensor_data.bin','rb').read()
data = zlib.decompress(raw, wbits=-15)
print("decompressed len", len(data))

def crc16(data):
    crc = 0
    for b in data:
        crc ^= b << 8
        for _ in range(8):
            crc = ((crc << 1) ^ 0x1021) & 0xFFFF if crc & 0x8000 else (crc << 1) & 0xFFFF
    return crc

off = 0
n = len(data)
i = 0
while off < n:
    i += 1
    t = data[off]
    ts = int.from_bytes(data[off+1:off+9],'little')
    kl = int.from_bytes(data[off+9:off+11],'little')
    key = data[off+11:off+11+kl].decode('utf-8')
    p = off+11+kl
    vl = int.from_bytes(data[p:p+4],'little')
    vl_actual = 8 if t == 3 else vl
    val_bytes = data[p+4:p+4+vl_actual]
    crc_stored = int.from_bytes(data[p+4+vl_actual:p+6+vl_actual],'little')
    body = data[off:p+4+vl_actual]
    crc_calc = crc16(body)
    ok = crc_calc == crc_stored
    if t == 3:
        val = struct.unpack('<d', val_bytes)[0]
    else:
        val = val_bytes.decode('utf-8')
    print(f"[{i}] off={off} type={t} ts={ts} key={key!r} vlen={vl} val={val!r} stored={crc_stored:04x} calc={crc_calc:04x} {'OK' if ok else 'BAD'}")
    off = p + 6 + vl_actual

python3 << 'EOF'
import zlib, struct, json

raw = open('/app/sensor_data.bin','rb').read()
data = zlib.decompress(raw, wbits=-15)

def crc16(data):
    crc = 0
    for b in data:
        crc ^= b << 8
        for _ in range(8):
            crc = ((crc << 1) ^ 0x1021) & 0xFFFF if crc & 0x8000 else (crc << 1) & 0xFFFF
    return crc

records = []
off = 0
n = len(data)
while off < n:
    t = data[off]
    ts = int.from_bytes(data[off+1:off+9],'little')
    kl = int.from_bytes(data[off+9:off+11],'little')
    key = data[off+11:off+11+kl].decode('utf-8')
    p = off+11+kl
    vl = int.from_bytes(data[p:p+4],'little')
    vl_actual = 8 if t == 3 else vl  # type 3 is fixed 8-byte float64; guards against damaged vlen
    val_bytes = data[p+4:p+4+vl_actual]
    crc_stored = int.from_bytes(data[p+4+vl_actual:p+6+vl_actual],'little')
    body = data[off:p+4+vl_actual]
    if crc16(body) == crc_stored:
        if t == 3:
            val = struct.unpack('<d', val_bytes)[0]
        else:
            val = val_bytes.decode('utf-8')
        records.append({"type": t, "timestamp": ts, "key": key, "value": val})
    off = p + 6 + vl_actual

with open('/app/valid_records.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(records, f, indent=2)
print(f"wrote {len(records)} valid records")
